flags.message: An ROA is permitted in three situations — further advice (reg 7.7.10AE), no buy or sell (reg 7.7.10AAA), small investment (s946AA) — and which one applies changes the content the record must contain and whether a prior SOA is required at all. The document type does not settle it, so filing an ROA without recording its basis loses the fact that determines what a compliant record looks like. This is a confirmation, never an error: all three are valid.
